title: Smiling Young Woman in Dark Dress by House, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: An outdoor snapshot of a smiling young woman posing directly in front of the horizontal wood siding of a residential home, beside a double-hung window. Her brunette hair is curled in a style typical of the early 1940s World War II era. She wears a tailored dark dress featuring three-quarter sleeves and delicate decorative accents at the shoulders and waistline.
